prompt.es: Escribe el mensaje final de la mediación a Ana y Leo.

answer.text:
Dear Ana and Leo,
Thank you both for talking openly today. Let me summarise what I heard. Ana, it sounds like you feel overwhelmed when the Sunday plans change at the last minute, and you need to know earlier. Leo, what I'm hearing is that you feel left out when you cannot see your friends, and you need some free time. Neither of you is wrong: you both want a calm weekend and to feel respected.
What if we try a compromise? Leo will tell Ana by Friday evening if he has other plans. Ana will keep Sunday lunch free until then, and she will not ask him to cancel later. If either of you feels upset, please say it with an I-message, for example, I feel frustrated when...
So we agreed that we will follow this plan for two weeks. Let's review it next Sunday, and we can change anything that does not work.
Thank you both for your honesty and your patience. I am proud of how you listened to each other, and I hope that this small plan helps you to enjoy your Sundays again.
Mia

Hi Ana and Leo,
I'm glad we talked. To summarise: Ana, it sounds like you feel stressed because the plans for Sunday lunch change suddenly, and you need time to organise. Leo, it sounds like you feel frustrated because you rarely see your friends, and you need space. I think you both want the same thing, which is a peaceful home where everybody feels heard.
Could we agree on a simple solution? Leo will tell Ana by Friday whether he is free on Sunday. In return, Ana will not plan the lunch until she hears from him. If there is a problem, we will speak calmly and take a break first.
So we agreed that this starts this week. We will check in again in two weeks, and then we will decide if we keep it.
Thanks for listening to each other. I'm proud of both of you, and I hope that the plan makes Sundays calmer and happier for everybody in the family. If either of you feels upset before then, please say it with an I-message and we will talk.
Mia

feedback.es: Un buen mensaje de mediación resume las dos posturas con equilibrio, reformula emociones, propone una salida y fija el acuerdo y su revisión.

origin.text: Ana se siente agobiada cuando Leo cambia a última hora los planes del domingo y necesita saberlo antes. Leo se siente excluido cuando no puede ver a sus amigos y necesita tiempo libre. Como mediador, escribe un mensaje a los dos (unas 150–270 palabras): resume ambas posturas con equilibrio, reformula sus emociones sin culpar, propone una salida con What if o Could we agree, y fija lo acordado y su revisión.
